visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman sits in a brightly lit indoor living room, holding a colorful children's picture book. She is wearing a brown cardigan over a dark shirt and light green slippers. To her left, a young girl with pigtails and a white vest stands watching, while another young girl in a beige sweatshirt sits in the woman's lap, pointing at the book. The room is filled with toys, a shelf, and a white air purifier in the background. (2) The woman continues reading, pointing at different animal characters on the pages. The girl in her lap watches intently. The camera captures close-up shots of the book's illustrations, which include a rabbit, a dog, and a pig. The lighting remains soft and natural from a nearby window. (3) As the woman turns to a page featuring a green, textured monster, the girls' reactions change. One girl stands up and walks away toward a small play tent in the background. The woman holds the book open, showing a large green monster illustration covering both pages. The room is spacious with light wood floors. (4) The camera follows the girl as she walks back and forth, looking tentatively at the book from a distance. The woman continues to point at the monster illustration, smiling and looking at the girl. The background shows more of the living area, including a kitchen counter in the distance and various toys scattered on the floor. (5) The woman encourages the girls to smell the book. One girl approaches, leans down, and sniffs the page, then smiles and stands back up. The other girl remains standing further away, looking at the scene. The video ends with a shot of the young girl standing in a corner of the room by a wooden toy shelf, looking towards the camera with a neutral expression, followed by a pink logo screen with an animated character.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The mother is wearing a warm brown knitted cardigan over a black top and light green slippers. The two young girls are wearing casual indoor clothing; one in a beige sweatshirt and brown pants, the other in a white patterned top with a beige fleece vest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern, clean indoor living room with light wood flooring. In the background, there is a wooden toy shelf filled with organized bins, a small play tent, an air purifier, and large windows letting in bright natural light.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice in a warm, narrative tone, reading a story in Mandarin Chinese. A bright, lighthearted acoustic guitar BGM plays at a moderate tempo. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs as the speaker highlights a rabbit in the book. The voice remains high-arousal and friendly. (3) A 'whoosh' sound transition occurs as the scene cuts. The speaker continues reading with a clear, enunciated delivery, and soft laughter from children is audible in the background. (4) As the children react to the monster in the book, the speaker's tone becomes more playful and slightly exaggerated, mimicking a character. A 'pop' SFX is heard. (5) The speaker asks the children if they are 'stinky,' with a rising intonation. The children respond with soft, high-pitched voices. The background music continues consistently. (6) A final soft 'ding' sound accompanies the young girl smelling the book, followed by the speaker's upbeat confirmation 'Right, very fragrant.' The BGM fades out as the video ends.
